behavior: Selects platform/architecture and resolves the exact @oven/bun platform optional dependency.
Executes the optional platform binary with --version.
Renames the binary into bun/bin/bun.exe, then hard-links or copies bun/bin/bunx.exe.
If optional resolution or binary execution fails, invokes npm install of the exact platform package in a temporary directory, then can download its exact-version tarball from registry.npmjs.org.
The fallback tarball path is outside Bun lockfile integrity verification; it is not necessary when the supported optional package resolves.
The shell installer command in optimizeBun is error text, not an executed curl/shell installer.
boundary: Script can execute Node, the optional Bun binary, sysctl on translated macOS x64, or npm on fallback.
Filesystem operations modify the dependency tree and owned temporary directories; no global install path is selected.
Explicit trust permits this complete reviewed script; an allowlist alone does not disable its npm/download fallback.
Keep optional dependencies enabled, use an environment without supplied secrets, and stop on any fallback diagnostics for investigation.

behavior: The helper resolves matching optional native binaries; if absent it can run npm install and directly download a registry tarball.

The runtime fallback invoking napi-postinstall is guarded by process.versions.webcontainer; that path is outside this local macOS Bun proof.
